## Status and question

This is an executable analytical template, not a completed study. How can paid national service expand youth opportunity, workforce development, and civic participation, and what does existing evidence suggest about effectiveness and equitable access?

## Source inventory readiness

```{r}
#| label: inventory-validation
# Resolve the repository root both from Quarto's document directory and repo root.
root <- normalizePath(".")
while (!file.exists(file.path(root, "renv.lock"))) {
  parent <- dirname(root)
  if (identical(parent, root)) stop("Run this report inside the TSP repository.")
  root <- parent
}
source(file.path(root, "research-projects/national-service/src/validate-inventory.R"))
inventory <- validate_inventory(file.path(root, "research-projects/national-service/source-inventory.csv"))
data.frame(sources = nrow(inventory), verified = sum(inventory$verification_status == "verified"))
```

The readiness counts above describe the inventory only. Zero sources means there is no evidence available for analysis. Do not interpret this template as program evaluation.
